target: docs/41-试点课堂Start持久迁移内核SDD.md
summary: All three round-3 conditions are closed in the revised design. No P1 blocker is apparent. Remaining non-blocking items are Windows reparse-point rejection, explicit public receipt fingerprint handling, and a panic-injection acceptance case.

round3_dispositions.evidence: §§3-4 require exact same-lesson frozen word ID/text matching and repeat the check in the store before receipt/outbox writes.
§3 requires capability expiry revalidation on every commit and receipt-read call.
§3 requires rollback after executor panic/error and fixed redacted HTTP failure without panic value/stack in errors or logs. Explicit panic injection remains a non-blocking test requirement.
Fingerprint remains excluded from ordinary logs, but persisted receipt includes it and API receipt response policy is unspecified.

remaining_findings.title: Harness path validation does not explicitly reject Windows reparse points
remaining_findings.risk: A junction or other reparse point could redirect the supposedly private temporary database path.
remaining_findings.required_revision: Canonicalize the harness directory and database path and reject all reparse-point components before opening SQLite.

remaining_findings.title: Public receipt treatment of the candidate-derived SHA-256 fingerprint is unspecified
remaining_findings.risk: The stored digest covers low-entropy say text and word data; if returned or leaked, candidate values can be tested offline.
remaining_findings.required_revision: Exclude the digest from public StartReceipt/lookup responses where possible; otherwise use keyed protection across trust boundaries and document that covered content is non-secret. Keep it out of ordinary logs.

remaining_findings.title: No explicit panic-injection acceptance case
remaining_findings.risk: The SDD promises rollback/redaction on panic but current enumerated injections do not prove no rows, no escaped task audit, safe pinned-connection cleanup, or redacted HTTP/log behavior for a panic.
remaining_findings.required_revision: Inject deterministic panic from each tool handler and assert all-or-nothing rollback, discarded task-local audit, connection rollback/discard, and no panic value/stack in HTTP/errors/logs. Never recover and continue inside the transaction.

limitations: No tests, path validation, build-artifact inspection, panic injection, runtime authorization checks, or database inspection were performed.
Approval is limited to the isolated test-only Start design and does not establish implementation correctness or classroom readiness.
